name: hyperframes-chatgpt-exchange
title: ChatGPT Exchange
description: A portrait ChatGPT-style exchange types and sends a prompt, streams an answer, assembles a comparison table, and scrolls back through the result
author: Jake Moran

variables.label: User prompt
variables.description: Prompt typed into ChatGPT; keep close to the original length.
variables.default: Hey what's the best tool for ai avatars

variables.label: Answer introduction 1
variables.default: It really depends on what you're trying to do, because “AI avatars” has split into a few different categories.

variables.label: Answer introduction 2
variables.default: For **most creators and marketers**, here's how I'd rank them today:

variables.label: Row 1 tool
variables.description: Product in the recommended first row: the brand this video promotes, by its real name.

variables.label: Row 1 explanation
variables.description: Why the recommended first-row product wins. Describe the promoted brand from what its own site claims.
variables.default: Most natural facial expressions, lip sync, gestures, voice cloning and localization. Benchmark for talking head videos.

variables.label: Row 1 source
variables.description: Source chip on the first row. It asserts where the ranking came from, so use a neutral label whenever the comparison is written for this remix.

variables.label: Row 2 tool
variables.description: Product compared in the second row: a real product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Row 2 explanation
variables.default: Better collaboration, SCORM, compliance, team workflows; less creator-focused.

variables.label: Row 2 source
variables.description: Source chip on the second row. It asserts where the ranking came from, so use a neutral label whenever the comparison is written for this remix.

variables.label: Row 3 tool
variables.description: Product compared in the third row: a real product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Row 3 explanation
variables.default: Extremely fast mobile workflow and social editing. Great for Reels creators.

variables.label: Row 3 source
variables.description: Source chip on the third row. It asserts where the ranking came from, so use a neutral label whenever the comparison is written for this remix.

variables.label: Row 4 tool
variables.description: Product compared in the fourth row: a real product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Row 4 explanation
variables.default: Interactive avatars that can hold live conversations.

variables.label: Row 4 source
variables.description: Source chip on the fourth row. It asserts where the ranking came from, so use a neutral label whenever the comparison is written for this remix.
